subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Inventory in the Age of Omnichannel
description: One-minute skill: Inventory in the Age of Omnichannel.

hook.text: A customer orders online, picks up in store, and returns by mail. One sale, three inventory touchpoints.

buildup.text: Omnichannel retail merges online and offline inventory into a single pool customers can access any way they choose.

discovery.text: It requires real-time inventory visibility across all stores, warehouses, and distribution centers.

twist.text: Allocating the last unit is tricky. Should it go to the in-store shopper or the online order? Conflicts arise.

climax.text: Retailers with true omnichannel inventory see 15–25% higher sales by never showing 'out of stock' to anyone.

punchline.text: One pool of inventory, every channel. That's omnichannel.
